advice_not_proof: Unanimous advice at high confidence is still advice, not proof. The decision rests on the scope and lineage evidence below, with Jev as a check on my framing, not a vote to follow blindly.
dissent_analysis: No dissent: 3-0 for new_store_package (p 0.91/0.96/0.96, extend_s3 at 0.00 in all three) and 3-0 for compose_token_in_adapter (p 0.96/0.87/0.91). The package verdict tracks the hard constraint both framings centered: K27's normative no-sharing scope bars executable overlap with the adapter lane, and s3:: IS the live-client lane, so extend_s3 fails the scope test structurally, not aesthetically. The store-vs-objects noun split (0.09/0.04/0.04 for objects) is a harmless preference: store:: continues the service-class noun (ObjectStoreService/ObjectStoreError) exactly as db:: continued DbObserver, so generated Can reads the same noun in TS and Can. The token verdict tracks the wrapper lineage: I13-16 return tokens alongside facts in every family, and composition keeps the explicitly test-only readout out of the stable catalogue while still exercising it on every open; expose_token_op would normalize a ForTest accessor as permanent surface. ROUND 2 (corrected): 3-0 for expose_token_op at near-certainty (T2/T3 parity-patched and resent; v1 sends agreed). The flip from round 1 is fully explained by the corrected precedent: withheld-token services get verbatim token verbs (I13), natively-returned tokens get paired wrappers (I14/I16). No residual tension: both rounds agree once the record is correct.
implementation_shape: New store:: package + store::store_fault{layer, code} error (fields layer, code, mirroring db::db_fault); 15 owner-first store:: ops under NT-I17 with owner elision (open_prefix/receipt/close_prefix/open_session/session_token_for_test/close_session/put/settle_write/pending/get/delete/compare_bytes/list/seal_cleanup/shared_digest); void where the service is void; bytes::buffer for put/get/compare_bytes; option::value<str> for the list continuation; ObjectStoreError->{layer, code} verbatim; adapter passes sessionTokenForTest through verbatim as store::session_token_for_test (open_session returns bare SessionFacts), exactly like db::connection_token_for_test; held service constructed under the K27 control vocabulary (both grants + sharedBucket seed + roomyLimits); verbatim service.ts port to runtime/test-support/slices/i17/; Can package with vocabularies + per-op wrappers + typed example; provisional until P14.
framing_correction: Round 1 recommended compose_token_in_adapter 3-0, but its state mis-framed the lineage: it cited the I14/I16 fact-plus-token wrappers as covering withheld tokens while omitting the directly identical I13 precedent (db::pin_connection returns tokenless facts; db::connection_token_for_test merged verbatim as its own op). The I14/I16 wrappers pair tokens their services return natively — no composition exists there — so round 1's lineage argument was false. Corrected round 2 (same 2 options, corrected record, fresh prose x3) recommends expose_token_op 3-0 at p 1.0/0.99/0.99. The round-1 token advice was a framing artifact; it is superseded, not averaged.
